detailed_descriptions.en: BOOST VECTOR EX is stylish high-speed parkour racing at its finest. With speeds unapologetically fast. Race unique, fully handcrafted maps. Race vertical beaches, down the sides of megalithic skyscrapers, or unreal dreamscapes that are totally not existential in nature! Each one made with a great deal of care, no two maps are alike. Easy to learn. Full of depth. Fully dynamic. Control the VECTOR MASTERS, each one unique and vastly different from one another. Utilizing their own BOOST and STYLE that gives them an edge on the circuit, completely changing their movement in all aspects. Perform moves such as: Sliding into a charge jump into a side-strafe into a wall-ride, do a couple tricks, and then boost your way on out. There are many ways to tackle a circuit in unique ways. Let nothing stop your momentum. Just Boost. It's in your soul. And... It's in the name. (duh) This is a dedicated section in the description just for this. That's how important it is! Talk with the Masters and grow your bonds! A full-on, fully fleshed out narrative-based story that takes place in an distant land of Walls... Learn about the various aspect of Vector Racing as it debuts as a sport! Get to know the Masters that hone their craft. From legendary tuners, to street-racing legends. The art of Vector Racing is a unforgiving one. Play with friends, random people, or your rivals... Take on lobbies of the best racers imaginable! Chances are they'll do some dastardly shortcuts no one dare attempt otherwise. Other features include: Full Mod Support! Global Leaderboards and Records! Big lore dumps related to our other game, neonKnights! Taxes! A Wordle-Clone amply named 'Blockle' 'Horse' Racing? …And so much more! Run fast. Faster than any other.
